messages:
paul-partnerops: Quick sync — we're T-10 days to marketplace listing. Need final signoff on press embargo windows, partner assets, SI integration test plan, and launch-day oncall roster. Can folks confirm owners and blockers? :calendar:

maria-marketing: I can own press/landing copy. Waiting on legal for embargo date (asked them this morning). Prefer Thurs 11am PT embargo release. @amy-pr fyi

amy-pr: Thurs 11am PT works for press contacts. Need final talking points by Tue EOD. I'll prepare draft.

leo-partner: Hardware partners confirmed asset drops by Mon (logos, certs). One partner needs co-branding review — pinged design.

jon-eng: SI integration smoke tests scheduled Wed-Fri. Need test credentials from partners by Tue morning. Also raising a perf concern for 6k token demos — @sophia-ops can we get a capacity bump on Dedicated for launch window?

sophia-ops: We can provision burst capacity for launch day, but need exact window and expected RPS. Send numbers and I'll route to infra.

sam-sales: Sales enablement doc is 80% — will add partner FAQs and pricing bullets by Tue.

paul-partnerops: Okay action items:
```
- Press embargo owner: @maria-marketing (talking points to @amy-pr by Tue EOD)
- Partner assets: @leo-partner (final by Mon)
- SI creds/test data: @leo-partner -> to @jon-eng by Tue morning
- Capacity window: @jon-eng to provide RPS + token profile to @sophia-ops
- Sales enablement: @sam-sales (finalize Tue)
- Oncall roster: volunteers? Need 3 people for 24-hr coverage starting launch day
```

maria-marketing: added to calendar. Sharing Google doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace-launch (draft)

amy-pr: I'll loop in press list. Can we get a short demo video from eng by Wed?

jon-eng: Will record a 60s demo and upload to the doc by Wed AM.

sophia-ops: Volunteers for launch oncall: @paul-partnerops, @jon-eng, @sophia-ops — I'll take midnight-8am slot. Need one more for 8am-4pm.

paul-partnerops: @sam-sales can you cover 8am-4pm? If not, @leo-partner?

sam-sales: I can do 8am-4pm.

leo-partner: Ok to jump in if needed backup. :thumbsup: 

paul-partnerops: Great. Last ask: any embargo or channel conflicts with partner marketplaces (AWS Marketplace etc.)? Ping me if yes.

leo-partner: AWS listing sync complete. Azure marketplace still pending legal note — target Tue.

paul-partnerops: Perfect. Will synthesize notes and update the doc. Thanks all :rocket:
